tor.title: Tor for wallet connections
tor.scope: Wallet RPCs use your local Tor service. Free2Z API, enrollment, parameter downloads and external links are blocked while enabled. Other apps are not covered.
tor.details: Requires an independently managed Tor SOCKS5 service at 127.0.0.1:9050. Hostnames go to the proxy. ZUULI does not start Tor, verify its identity or measure bootstrap progress. A proxy connection is not proof of Tor. Returning from background or changing networks requires Reconnect.
tor.mobile: Android and iOS signed-device acceptance is still open. No bundled mobile Tor runtime or system-wide protection is provided.
tor.waiting: Waiting for a wallet request through the proxy
tor.web: Available only in the native app
tor.error: Connection change failed · check native state before continuing
